header: The Great Wall of China is not visible from the Moon, and astronauts say it is extremely hard to see from orbit without a camera.

list.snippet: Most of the wall is less than 10 metres wide, so it is too narrow to see from very far away.
Yang Liwei, China's first astronaut, reported in 2003 that he could not see it.
Photos taken from the space station with long lenses have shown sections of it.

references.title: Is China's Great Wall Visible from Space?
